result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The main defect is the promo banner, where white text sits on a pale mint background and is nearly unreadable. The first 'Fastest near you' card also has a minor layout inconsistency.

issues.description: The promo banner headline '3 free deliveries for you' and the subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are white on a very light mint background. Contrast is extremely low and the promo code is almost illegible.
issues.suggestion: Use a dark or saturated text color on the light background, or give the banner a darker green background so the white text reaches at least 4.5:1 contrast (3:1 for the large headline).

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Green Bowl Poké image is a light, low-contrast plate on a pale gray background, and the time pill (15–25 min) overlaps the plate. The card looks washed out and inconsistent next to the darker cards.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent image treatment, such as a darker background or an overlay, and position the time badge so it doesn't collide with the main subject.

issues.description: The white 'Order now' button on the pale banner has weak separation from its background. The heart icon on the pizza card sits on a semi-transparent dark circle that blends into the image.
issues.suggestion: Add a stronger border or shadow to the button, and use a more opaque background for the favorite icon.
